description: This is a comprehensive SQL script for managing a unified 'work_item' table in a PostgreSQL database, including table creation, triggers, functions, policies, and index configurations related to work items with project-specific incremental IDs and auto-generated item keys.

methods.name: public.fn_work_item_assign_incremental_id
methods.description: Assigns the next available incremental ID for a work_item within a specific project before insertion.

methods.name: public.fn_work_item_set_item_key
methods.description: Sets or updates the item_key based on the project's project_key and the item ID after it is assigned.
